## 2. Core Technical Competencies

### Frontend Development
- Languages & Core: HTML5 (Semantic, Accessible), CSS3/Modern CSS (Grid, Flexbox, Custom Properties, Glassmorphism), Modern JavaScript (ES2022+).
- Frameworks & Libraries: React, Redux, DOM manipulation, HTML5 Canvas 2D rendering.
- Performance: 60 FPS animations, sub-second initial paint, asset optimization, service worker offline caching.

### Backend Engineering
- Environments & Frameworks: Node.js, Express.js, PHP, Laravel.
- API Design: RESTful endpoints, WebSockets (real-time bidirectionality), Server-Sent Events (SSE), RPC patterns.
- Authentication & Security: JWT, OAuth2, session management, CSRF/XSS protection, role-based access control (RBAC).

### Data & Storage
- Relational Databases: PostgreSQL (complex joins, indexing, query optimization, triggers), MySQL.
- In-Memory & Caching: Redis (caching, pub/sub, session state).
- BaaS & Cloud DBs: Supabase, Firebase (Firestore, Auth).

### Embedded & IoT Systems
- Platforms: ESP32, ESP8266, Arduino AVR/ARM.
- Protocols & Communication: MQTT, WebSockets, HTTP REST over Wi-Fi, SPI, I2C, UART.
- Applications: Sensor telemetry, hardware-to-cloud pipelines, remote telemetry dashboards.

## 3. Production Projects & Architectural Details

### CognitoAttend
- URL: https://vivek-yadav.com/project-cognitoattend.html
- Purpose: Frictionless identity tracking and cognitive attendance monitoring.
- Architecture: Microservice backend powered by Node.js and PostgreSQL. Features real-time state synchronization and automated attendance reporting.

### JhatpatSewa
- URL: https://vivek-yadav.com/project-jhatpatsewa.html
- Purpose: On-demand marketplace connecting consumers with vetted home service technicians in real time.
- Architecture: Laravel backend, MySQL relational model, integrated payment gateways, dynamic scheduling, and geolocation-based dispatch.

### NeoRide
- URL: https://vivek-yadav.com/project-neoride.html
- Purpose: Demonstration of pure DOM rendering capabilities without canvas or graphic textures.
- Highlights: Interactive vehicular physics, obstacle collision detection, and procedural movement utilizing CSS transforms and requestAnimationFrame.

### Star Cadet
- URL: https://vivek-yadav.com/project-starcadet.html
- Purpose: Gamified interactive STEM education tool.
- Highlights: Custom 2D particle engine, mathematical simulation, and stable 60 FPS rendering cycle tuned for low-spec client hardware.

### MediaConverter
- URL: https://vivek-yadav.com/project-mediaconverter.html
- Purpose: Universal format conversion engine for images, documents, and audio.
- Highlights: Hybrid client-side WebAssembly and server-side processing for instant conversions.
